CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH lists AS (
    SELECT ml.moira_list_key, TRIM(ml.moira_list_name) AS list_name
    FROM moira_list ml
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(ml.moira_list_name)) LIKE 'C%'
      AND COALESCE(ml.is_active,'Y') = 'Y'
      AND COALESCE(ml.is_moira_mailing_list,'Y') = 'Y'
), members AS (
    SELECT d.moira_list_key,
           CAST(d.moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    WHERE d.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL
), list_members AS (
    SELECT l.list_name, l.moira_list_key, m.mit_id
    FROM lists l
    JOIN members m ON m.moira_list_key = l.moira_list_key
), summer_faculty AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(sos.responsible_faculty_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM subject_offered_summary sos
    JOIN academic_terms at ON at.term_code = sos.term_code
    WHERE at.financial_aid_year IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(at.financial_aid_year AS INTEGER) > 2001
      AND LOWER(at.term_description) LIKE '%summer%'
), counts AS (
    SELECT lm.list_name,
           COUNT(*) AS total_members,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lm.mit_id IN (SELECT mit_id FROM summer_faculty) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS summer_faculty_in_list
    FROM list_members lm
    GROUP BY lm.list_name
)
SELECT list_name AS email_list_name,
       total_members AS total_people_in_list,
       summer_faculty_in_list AS faculty_in_list
FROM counts
ORDER BY email_list_name
LIMIT 200

# Count members and how many are summer faculty post-2001; coerce IDs carefully, intersect with HR roster to ensure personhood
import pandas as pd

query = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH lists AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ml.moira_list_key) AS moira_list_key,
           TRIM(ml.moira_list_name) AS list_name
    FROM moira_list ml
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(ml.moira_list_name)) LIKE 'C%'
      AND COALESCE(ml.is_active,'Y') = 'Y'
      AND COALESCE(ml.is_moira_mailing_list,'Y') = 'Y'
), members AS (
    SELECT TRIM(d.moira_list_key) AS moira_list_key,
           -- moira_list_member_mit_id is DOUBLE; cast via string to avoid scientific/decimal issues
           TRY_CAST(CAST(d.moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    WHERE d.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL
), list_members AS (
    SELECT l.list_name, l.moira_list_key, m.mit_id
    FROM lists l
    JOIN members m ON m.moira_list_key = l.moira_list_key
    WHERE m.mit_id IS NOT NULL
), hr_fac AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(h.mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM hr_faculty_roster h
), summer_instructors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(sos.responsible_faculty_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
    FROM subject_offered_summary sos
    JOIN academic_terms at2 ON at2.term_code = sos.term_code
    WHERE sos.responsible_faculty_mit_id IS NOT NULL
      AND at2.financial_aid_year IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(at2.financial_aid_year AS INTEGER) > 2001
      AND LOWER(at2.term_description) LIKE '%summer%'
), summer_faculty AS (
    -- Restrict to those who are in HR faculty roster to reduce noise
    SELECT DISTINCT s.mit_id
    FROM summer_instructors s
    JOIN hr_fac h ON h.mit_id = s.mit_id
), counts AS (
    SELECT lm.list_name,
           COUNT(*) AS total_people_in_list,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lm.mit_id IN (SELECT mit_id FROM summer_faculty) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faculty_in_list
    FROM list_members lm
    GROUP BY lm.list_name
)
SELECT list_name AS email_list_name,
       total_people_in_list,
       faculty_in_list
FROM counts
ORDER BY email_list_name
LIMIT 200
"""
